children.name: Pandion
children.description: One of the most cosmopolitan raptors, found on every continent except Antarctica. Adapted entirely for catching fish — reversible outer toe, spiny toe pads, closeable nostrils for diving. Sweden has one of Europe's largest osprey populations, over 4,000 pairs nesting on prominent dead snags above lakes and rivers.

children.name: Pandion haliaetus
children.description:
The osprey (; Pandion haliaetus), historically known as sea hawk, river hawk, and fish hawk, is a diurnal, fish-eating bird of prey with a cosmopolitan range. It is a large raptor, reaching more than in length and a wingspan. It is brown on the upperparts and predominantly greyish on the head and underparts.
The osprey is distributed on all continents except Antarctica, but in South America, it occurs only as a nonbreeding migrant. It lives in a wide variety of habitats and nests in locations near a body of water providing an adequate food supply. It has specialised physical characteristics and unique behaviour in hunting its prey, which consists almost exclusively of fish.

children.name: Pandion cristatus
children.description: The eastern osprey (Pandion haliaetus cristatus) is a diurnal, fish-eating bird of prey.
